task.description:
Execute all tests for EE-11 (State reconstruction) per the spec at tests/specs/EE-11.md.

Run:
  zig build test

Also run integration tests if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is set:
  zig build test-integration

Write a structured test report to tests/reports/EE-11-test-report.md covering:
- Total tests run, passed, failed
- Result for each test case in the spec
- NFR-04 measurement: actual time for 10,000-event replay
- Any failures with full error output

If any test fails, set result.status = FAIL and list each failure in result.issues with severity CRITICAL or HIGH.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 with all EE-11 unit tests passing
NFR-04 timing result documented (actual seconds for 10,000-event replay)
All 9 test cases from EE-11.md have a pass/fail result
result.status = PASS only if all tests pass and NFR-04 time ≤ 5 seconds

result.summary: zig build test exits 0; 3/3 EE-11 unit tests pass (TC-EE-11-U01, TC-EE-11-U02, TC-EE-11-U03). Integration tests (TC-EE-11-01 through TC-EE-11-09) deferred — BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set and ee11_reconstruction_test.zig not yet implemented. NFR-04 deferred to integration.
